content.storyline: A UCLA win over rival USC would send the Bruins to the Big Ten title game, making this matchup consequential to the conference race.
matchup_notes: Entering the matchup, UCLA was 10-1 (7-1 Big Ten) and USC was 8-3 (5-3 Big Ten).
UCLA’s first loss came against Michigan, 18-16 in triple overtime on Nov. 21.
USC most recently beat Maryland 35-21; Waymond Jordan and Trent Mosley each scored twice.
UCLA had not clinched a Big Ten title-game berth after Week 12; a win over USC would send the Bruins to the championship game.
As of Nov. 23, UCLA quarterback Ty Dieffenbach was not ruled out against USC after a minor hip injury, but he was not yet in the clear.
